name: Whole Grain Brown Rice (Insoluble Bran Coat Warning)
whyItWorks: While often promoted as 'healthy', brown rice retains the tough, fibrous, insoluble outer bran hull. This sharp silica-rich hull resists digestion and rubs abrasively against inflamed mucosal ulcers, accelerating cramping and loose stools.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Flare Warning: Avoid brown rice, wild rice, and black rice during active disease. Switch exclusively to polished white Jasmine, Basmati, or sushi rice.
watchOuts: The insoluble bran coat mechanically scratches inflamed ulcerations and causes severe bloating.
